title: (Scripture Reading Exercise.)
author: B. H. Roberts
note: Fifth Year (final) of the Seventy's Course in Theology. Focuses on divine immanence, the Holy Spirit, and nature of God.

footnotes.text: That is, doubtless, a sin which kills the spiritual life in man; that breaks this union with God--the sin against the Holy Ghost which men have of God, and they become spiritually dead--and it is impossible to revive them to life again. (See Heb. vi:6.)
Outlines of Ecclesiastical History, pp. 419-421, 3rd edition.
The Revelation is in Doc. and Cov., Sec. lxxvi:25-49.
